# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *
# endregion

class PermanentPortfolioAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    _weight = 0.6
    _complement_weight = 0.4
    _drift_threshold = 0.05

    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2022, 1, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(100000)
        self.settings.seed_initial_prices = True

        for ticker in ["SPY", "TLT"]:
            security = self.add_equity(ticker, Resolution.MINUTE)
            self._targets.append(PortfolioTarget(security, self._weight))

        self.schedule.on(
            self.date_rules.quarter_start("SPY"),
            self.time_rules.after_market_open("SPY", 1),
            self._rebalance
        )

    def on_warmup_finished(self) -> None:
        self.set_holdings(self._targets, liquidate_existing_holdings=True)

    def _rebalance(self) -> None:
        for target in self._targets:
            current_weight = target.holdings_value / self.total_portfolio_value
            if abs(current_weight - self._weight) > self._drift_threshold:
                self.set_holdings(self._targets, liquidate_existing_holdings=True)
                return
